title: Almost no scent at all
text: Almost no scent at all. Ok, when I think about what my Texas smells like, I think of mesquite, sage, pine, leather, horses, and citrus. This candle just isn't Texas and frankly, it has zero scent after thirty minutes burning.  If you get right up to it and really concentrate, you get a whiff of lemon and something else that no one here could identity. At most, I might expect to spend ten bucks on this just because the candle is enormous, but I would never gift this to anyone.
